title: Minnesota lawyer suspended over fake AI case citations

reading.body:
The incident title indicates that a lawyer in Minnesota was suspended in connection with submitting fake case citations generated by an AI system. This belongs to a well-documented failure mode in which a generative AI model produces plausible-looking legal citations that do not correspond to real cases, and a user submits them in legal proceedings without independent verification. The failure occurs at the point of human use, after the model's output leaves the system, when no check against an authoritative legal database is performed before filing.

The article body was not retrievable, so the specific citations involved, the proceedings in which they appeared, the disciplinary body that imposed the suspension, and the precise scope of the suspension are not established from the available reporting.

What is known is only the headline claim: a suspension occurred and AI-generated fake citations were the stated reason. Whether the lawyer acted negligently or knowingly, and what the final disciplinary outcome entailed, are not established by the single inaccessible report.
